title: HHHusher review
description: One customer review: a row of five small yellow stars, a large medium-weight quote in the display face and the author in bold mono below it. Plain, no card.
notes: text takes the colour around it; made for the tan bands
name: hhhusher-review

props.name: ratingLabel
props.description: screen-reader text for the stars, e.g. "5 out of 5 stars"

props.name: authorStyle
props.description: caps: author in bold mono capitals (landing) · plain: author as written (review list)

props.name: size
props.description: lg: the 28px quote of the landing reviews · md: the 24px quote of the long list
